rejection_reason: PARKED 2026-10-30, three recorded blockers, none of which is a scientific rejection of the underlying data: (1) ACCESS: portal.tcu.gov.br serves its security block page to this environment's egress (supported browser included), and no machine-readable distribution of the Painel de Obras was located from here (dados.gov.br catalog API 401 unauthenticated; no catalog entry found by search). The panel's data model, per-work fields and any download capability are therefore UNVERIFIED. (2) STRUCTURE/SPLIT: only a handful of documented levantamento vintages exist (2018/2020/2022 + updates to April 2025) and the mapped base changes composition between them (27,126 -> 21,007 -> 22,621 obras), so a vintage-transition label needs cross-vintage work identity that is unproven and a transition-window count (<=4) that is marginal for train/eval/holdout; a rescue path exists only if the panel exposes per-work dated status history, which could not be checked. (3) PRIOR ART at target level: an UnB 2023 dissertation already models obra-paralisacao risk with ML (Proinfancia/FNDE, 94.79% accuracy), so any task here must state its formulation contribution against existing literature, not just the data source. REOPEN WHEN: a machine-readable distribution is reachable (official TCU download/API, a dados.gov.br entry, Wayback-archived panel exports, or access from an unblocked egress) AND it carries per-work dated status or multiple archived vintages; then re-examine structure and licence before any verdict. Licence remains unread and unclassified - not a class-C closure, since no terms page was readable at all.
review: Latin America tick lead (Brazil, named in the regional rotation). Conceptually attractive - infrastructure-delivery stall prediction is a genuinely useful task genre absent from the bench - but this session could not establish the three contracts that matter: machine-readable access (host blocks our egress), label construction (few vintages, unstable base composition, unknown per-work history fields), and licence (terms unread). The lead is parked with exact reopening conditions rather than dropped: the access failure is environment-specific, and TCU's press archive documents the panel's scale and vintage cadence well enough to re-attempt cheaply once access exists. Prior art note: target-level ML on Brazilian public-works stall risk already exists as a dissertation on FNDE/Proinfancia data (94.79% acc, no public benchmark); a TCU-panel task would need a stated formulation contribution.
